author: VANSMITHLAB
title: BIG — Bjarke Ingels Group
summary: An architecture practice influential in contemporary form, space and urban thinking in Copenhagen since 2006. It builds projects through clear diagrams that combine programme, environmental requirements and public scenarios into forms explainable through one transformation.

hero_image.alt: Timber and card massing models on a workshop table beside rolled drawings and a site plan held down at the corners.
hero_image.caption: Massing studies in the round: form tested as an object before it is tested as an image.
